provenance.section_title: Stage C HF: Nonpharmacological, Diuretics, and Pharmacological Treatment for HFrEF

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF should receive multidisciplinary team care and self-care support.
rules.citation: Multidisciplinary Team Care & Self [SNOMED: 384758001]-Care Support: Patients should receive care from multidisciplinary teams and specific education/support to facilitate HF self-care [SNOMED: 326051000000105] (Class 1).

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF should receive vaccinations (influenza, pneumococcal, COVID-19).
Patients with Stage C HF should restrict dietary sodium intake to less than 2.3 g/day.
rules.citation: Dietary [SNOMED: 41829006] Sodium [SNOMED: 39972003] Restriction [SNOMED: 263856008]: Avoiding excessive sodium intake [SNOMED: 440921000124100] (<2.3 g/day [SNOMED: 258829005]) is reasonable to reduce congestive symptoms (Class 2a).

rules.rationale: Eligible patients with Stage C HF should participate in exercise training or cardiac rehabilitation.
rules.citation: Activity [SNOMED: 68130003] & Rehabilitation [SNOMED: 52052004]: Exercise [SNOMED: 256235009] training [SNOMED: 118629009] or cardiac rehabilitation [SNOMED: 313395003] is recommended for eligible patients to improve functional status and QOL (Class 1).

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF and fluid retention should receive loop diuretics.
rules.citation: Loop diuretics [SNOMED: 372691009] (furosemide [SNOMED: 387475002], bumetanide [SNOMED: 387498005], torsemide [SNOMED: 108476002]) are recommended in patients with fluid retention [SNOMED: 43498006] to relieve [SNOMED: 397855004] congestion [SNOMED: 85804007] and maintain euvolemia (Class 1).

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF who are resistant to loop diuretics may require the addition of a thiazide diuretic.
rules.citation: Adding a thiazide [SNOMED: 860766002] (e.g., metolazone [SNOMED: 387123003]) is reserved [SNOMED: 1256105002] for diuretic [SNOMED: 372695000] resistance (Class 1).

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF and NYHA Class II-III HFrEF should be treated with an ARNI (sacubitril-valsartan).
rules.citation: ARNi (sacubitril-valsartan [SNOMED: 763540002]) is recommended in NYHA [SNOMED: 420816009] Class II-III HFrEF to reduce morbidity and mortality [SNOMED: 409651001] (Class 1, LOE A).

rules.rationale: If ARNI is not feasible, patients with Stage C HF should be treated with an ACEi or ARB.
rules.citation: If ARNi is not feasible, ACEi (or ARB [SNOMED: 96308008] if ACEi intolerant) is indicated (Class 1, LOE A).

rules.rationale: All symptomatic or asymptomatic patients with Stage C HF should be treated with a beta blocker (bisoprolol, carvedilol, metoprolol succinate).
rules.citation: Bisoprolol [SNOMED: 386868003], carvedilol [SNOMED: 386870007], or sustained [SNOMED: 263892007]-release [SNOMED: 58000006] metoprolol succinate [SNOMED: 412432007] are recommended for all symptomatic [SNOMED: 264931009] or asymptomatic HFrEF patients to reduce mortality [SNOMED: 409651001] and hospitalization [SNOMED: 394656005] (Class 1, LOE A).

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF (NYHA Class II-IV) and eGFR >30 mL/min/1.73m² and K+ <5.0 mEq/L should be treated with an MRA (spironolactone or eplerenone).
rules.citation: Spironolactone [SNOMED: 387078006] or eplerenone [SNOMED: 407010008] is recommended for NYHA [SNOMED: 420816009] Class II-IV [SNOMED: 255560000] HFrEF if eGFR [SNOMED: 86960007] >30 mL/min [SNOMED: 258859000]/1.73m² and K+ <5.0 mEq/L [SNOMED: 258865000] (Class 1, LOE A).

rules.rationale: Symptomatic patients with Stage C HF should be treated with an SGLT2 inhibitor (dapagliflozin or empagliflozin), regardless of diabetes status.
rules.citation: Dapagliflozin [SNOMED: 703674001] or empagliflozin [SNOMED: 703894008] is recommended for symptomatic [SNOMED: 264931009] chronic [SNOMED: 90734009] HFrEF, regardless of diabetes status, to reduce HF [SNOMED: 84114007] hospitalizations [SNOMED: 394656005] and cardiovascular [SNOMED: 113257007] mortality [SNOMED: 409651001] (Class 1, LOE A).

rules.rationale: Self-identified Black/African American patients with Stage C HF (NYHA Class III-IV) on optimal GDMT should be treated with hydralazine and isosorbide dinitrate.
rules.citation: Hydralazine [SNOMED: 387125005] and Isosorbide Dinitrate [SNOMED: 387332007]: Recommended for self-identified Black/African [SNOMED: 413464008] American patients with NYHA [SNOMED: 420816009] Class III-IV [SNOMED: 255560000] HFrEF on optimal GDMT (Class 1, LOE A).

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF (NYHA II-III) with LVEF ≤35% in sinus rhythm and resting HR ≥70 bpm on maximum tolerated beta blocker may benefit from ivabradine.
rules.citation: Ivabradine [SNOMED: 421228002]: Beneficial in NYHA [SNOMED: 420816009] II-III [SNOMED: 6651008] HFrEF (LVEF [SNOMED: 250908004] ≤35%) in sinus rhythm [SNOMED: 251150006] with resting [SNOMED: 258157001] HR [SNOMED: 364075005] ≥70 bpm [SNOMED: 258983007] on maximum [SNOMED: 398303009] tolerated beta blocker [SNOMED: 33252009] (Class 2a, LOE B-R).

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF may be considered for vericiguat if they are high-risk and have had recent worsening HF.
rules.citation: Vericiguat: Soluble guanylyl cyclase [SNOMED: 28954008] stimulator [SNOMED: 36645008] may be considered in high-risk HFrEF with recent worsening HF [SNOMED: 84114007] (Class 2b, LOE B-R).

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF who remain refractory may be considered for digoxin.
rules.citation: Digoxin [SNOMED: 387461009]: May be considered to reduce HF [SNOMED: 84114007] hospitalizations [SNOMED: 394656005] in refractory [SNOMED: 20646008] HFrEF (Class 2b, LOE B-R).

rules.rationale: Patients with Stage C HF may be considered for omega-3 PUFA supplementation as adjunctive therapy.
rules.citation: Omega-3 PUFA [SNOMED: 226365003]: Supplementation may be reasonable as adjunctive therapy (Class 2b, LOE B-R).
